title: console list page: the toolbar's settings cluster folds into one Display popover, view tabs size to their width and carry the view's type icon, the row-number cell yields to the checkbox on hover, and the page header is one row
body:
Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer dispatched in person (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill). The maintainer's words, verbatim: 「我关心的是平台整体界面的布局优化，帮我设计一个按照你的意见改进之后的版本给我看看。」, then on the first redesign draft 「有的的工具栏还是太多，是否建议文字去掉，视图切换是否建议改为下拉，或者你有更好的建议。」, and the dispatch order 「按这个方案在 objectui 开一个 issue，使用 dispatch 技能，然后你负责派发开发。开发完了使用右侧的浏览器测试验证并给我看效果。crm 本身的元数据不重要，我关心的还是平台的基础能力。」 The approved design is the interactive prototype at https://claude.ai/artifact/8JLqDFmcuK82RS1Cb8219f (private to the maintainer; the artboard "Leads 列表页 · 改进版" and its three notes). This card carries the platform half only; nothing in it is HotCRM metadata.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane, seat 3 (this session), one dev round across `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-view`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and the ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T03:58Z; the control query "per-user list state view tab order filter state sort column widths" answered #12418 as expected, so the channel was live for these reads): "list toolbar Display popover settings columns density group view type" → 3 (#12418 open, #11984 closed, #11642 closed); "view tabs overflow more maxVisibleTabs adaptive width tab strip" → 3 (#2959, #753, #637, all closed); "row numbers column grid showRowNumbers toggle checkbox hover selection" → 4 (#11816, #11322, #4140, #2159, all closed). None is this card. #12418 (per-user list state onto `sys_user_preference`) is the sibling that owns PERSISTENCE; this card changes what the toolbar shows and persists nothing new (see Out of scope).

## The problem in one screen

On a 1440-px desktop the Leads list of the HotCRM demo spends about 290 px of chrome before its first row — app bar, a two-line page header, the view-tab row, a second toolbar row, the table header — and the toolbar row offers up to twelve controls at once: the visualization switcher, Edit inline, Hide fields, Filter, Group, Sort, Color, Refresh, Export, Search, plus the view tabs' own filter/sort micro-icons. The saved-view strip shows a fixed four tabs and folds the rest into "4 more" whatever the width. Every row draws a row number AND a checkbox AND a row-actions button. The maintainer's verdict on the first redesign draft was that the row still carried too many controls. The agreed shape (the prototype above) is: saved-view tabs on the left sized to the width, four controls on the right — Filter, Sort, Display, Search — and everything else inside Display.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `fc528c3`, read 2026-10-15T03:56Z)

1. **The toolbar's right cluster** is `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` lines 4938–5500: `ViewSwitcherDropdown` (4943, when offered), the inline-edit toggle (4958), Hide fields (4976), Filter (5047), Group (5083), Sort (5131), Color (5207), the compact gear `ViewSettingsPopover` (5338, rendered only when `toolbarFlags.compactToolbar`), Refresh (5369), Export (5385), Search (5481). Hide fields, Group, Color and the inline-edit toggle each carry `!toolbarFlags.compactToolbar`, so the bundled form already exists as a MODE; it is not the desktop default.
2. **`packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`** (392 lines) already bundles Group, Color, Density, Hide fields and the inline-edit entry under one trigger, with the hint `list.viewSettingsHint` "Grouping, color, density, and visible fields. Applies to everyone who uses this view." It has no Layout row, no row-number row, no count of non-default settings and no reset.
3. **View tabs:** `packages/plugin-view/src/ViewTabBar.tsx` line 271 `maxVisibleTabs = 4` is the default cap, independent of width; line 870 is the overflow "N more" menu (`view.moreViews`) with the active-in-tail swap (352–363); lines 517 and 907 draw 10-px filter/sort micro-icons per tab. The console (`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` 4099) passes `viewTypeIcons={VIEW_TYPE_ICONS}` and no `maxVisibleTabs`, and feeds `hasActiveFilters` / `hasActiveSort` from the view's AUTHORED filter and sort (4085–4086), so the micro-icons say "this saved view has a filter", which the Filter button's own count already says once that view is active.
4. **Row numbers:** `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` line 5913 passes `showRowNumbers: true` unconditionally. `packages/spec` declares no row-number key on the list view (grep `showRowNumbers` over `packages/spec/src` on objectstack `origin/main` answers 0 files; the control grep `rowHeight` over the same tree answers hits), so it is a renderer default, not metadata.
5. **Row cells:** `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` 2878–2893 is the header select-all; 3206–3214 draws the row checkbox on every row unconditionally; 3216 is the row-number cell; the row-actions cell is always drawn.
6. **Page header:** `packages/app-shell/src/layout/PageHeader.tsx` 155–190 draws title and subtitle on two lines (an `h1` and a `p`, `py-2.5 sm:py-3`); the console passes the object description as `subtitle` (`ObjectView.tsx` 3888).

## What to build

**A. View row.**

1. `ViewTabBar`: the number of visible tabs is derived from the available width (measure the strip with a `ResizeObserver` or equivalent); the `maxVisibleTabs` config key becomes an optional CAP on top of that; the "N more" overflow with the active-in-tail swap stays exactly as pinned today (`data-testid="view-tab-overflow"` and its siblings keep their names).
2. A tab shows its view-type icon only for a non-default type (board, calendar, gallery, timeline and the rest: whatever `viewTypeIcons` resolves for a `view.type` other than the grid/list type); a grid tab shows the label alone. The per-tab filter/sort micro-icons (517, 907) are removed; `hasActiveFilters` / `hasActiveSort` stay on the prop type so a consumer may still pass them, but they draw nothing in the strip.

**B. Toolbar right cluster** (`ListView.tsx`), desktop: Filter, Sort, Display, Search, in that order, with the existing count chips on Filter and Sort.

3. **Display** is the existing `ViewSettingsPopover` promoted to the default desktop shape (today's `compactToolbar` behaviour becomes the default; keep the flag for a host that wants the wide form), relabelled with a new key `list.display` "Display", and extended with: a Layout row that hosts the existing `ViewSwitcherDropdown` content, shown only when `viewSwitcherOffered`; the existing Group, Color, Hide fields and Density rows; a Row numbers switch; the Edit inline entry as a switch; a footer with "Reset to view default" plus the existing Refresh and Export entries. The trigger shows a count chip of settings that differ from the view's authored defaults (same chip style as Filter and Sort) and carries `aria-expanded`.
4. Refresh and Export leave the bar (they live in the Display footer); the wide-form buttons Hide fields, Group, Color, Edit inline, Refresh and Export are no longer rendered by default on desktop.
5. Persistence stays EXACTLY what each control persists today (view settings through the existing write path; inline edit and the search term as they are). Row numbers is a session-only, in-memory setting defaulting to the renderer's current default (on). ⛔ No new storage key, no localStorage key, no preference slot: that is #12418's card.

**C. Grid rows** (`data-table.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`).

6. The leading cell draws the row number by default and swaps to the selection checkbox on row hover, on focus-within, and whenever the table's selection is non-empty (every row shows its checkbox while anything is selected). The header keeps its select-all checkbox always. With Row numbers off, the cell is blank until hover. No layout shift: one cell of fixed width, the two children toggled by CSS classes, not by mounting and unmounting.
7. The row-actions trigger is visible on row hover, on focus-within and when the row is selected (by opacity, never `display: none`, so it stays reachable by keyboard and assistive tech).

**D. Page header** (`PageHeader.tsx`): one row at desktop — icon, title, the favorite star, the description inline after a hairline divider (truncated; hidden below the `sm` breakpoint as the whole header already is), actions on the right; target height about 52 px. The managed-by badge stays where it is. Mobile unchanged.

**E. i18n:** every new key (`list.display`, `list.layout`, `list.rowNumbers`, `list.resetToViewDefault`, and whatever else is needed) lands in all ten locale packs; the parity tests decide the roster.

**F. Accessibility:** the Display trigger `aria-expanded`; the switches `role="switch"` with `aria-checked`; the hover-only controls stay focusable; no `role` on a div.

## Acceptance

- `ViewTabBar` tests: with a measured width that fits six tabs and eight views, six render and "2 more" lists two; choosing a folded view swaps it in; with `maxVisibleTabs: 3` and the same width, three render. A board, calendar or gallery tab renders its icon; a grid tab renders none; no filter/sort micro-icon renders for a view passed with `hasActiveFilters: true`.
- `ListView` tests: on desktop the right cluster renders exactly the Filter, Sort, Display and Search buttons (by testid); Hide fields, Group, Color, Edit inline, Refresh and Export are not in the bar; the Display popover contains Group, Hide fields, Density, Row numbers, Edit inline, Reset, Refresh and Export; the Layout row renders only when `viewSwitcherOffered`; the count chip is absent by default and reads 1 after density is changed; Reset removes it.
- `data-table` tests: a row renders its number and no visible checkbox by default; after one row is selected, every row renders its checkbox; the header checkbox is always present; the row-actions button is in the DOM for every row.
- `PageHeader` test: the title and the description render in one flex row (one `h1`, the description a sibling in the same row, no block paragraph under it).
- i18n parity green; `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (minor; user-visible) for every published package touched.
- Browser check on the terminal head: the seat drives the console against a running backend and screenshots the list page; those screenshots are the maintainer's acceptance view. The dev need not run a backend.

## Out of scope (named so nobody widens the PR)

- Persisting any Display setting per user: #12418.
- Removing the object breadcrumb from the app bar; moving `list_toolbar` metadata actions into the selection bar. Both are follow-up cards if the maintainer wants them.
- Any `packages/spec` change; any HotCRM metadata; the mobile layout.

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's instruction quoted above.
